caption:
Stuck inside on a snow day? Here are four pages from my new Cozy Winter book. ❄️

Sledding down the big hill, building a snowman, a bunny in a cozy scarf and a sleigh full of presents. I'd hand over the bunny first.

There are 50 winter pages in all, with a polar bear, Santa Claus, snowflakes, snowy trees and chimney scenes too. I kept the outlines thick and the shapes big, so they're easy for little hands.

It comes with 10 printable covers, so your kids can turn their pages into a real book. Pages are 8.5 x 8.5 in squares, and you can print them at home as many times as you like.

Christmas break, a classroom craft, or just a quiet hour with hot cocoa while the snow falls. It'll fit any of them.
